name: Coordinated Reposition [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
You are skilled in coordinating combat positioning with your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Step-Up.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally who is threatening a creature you are threatening takes a 5-foot step, you can move 5 feet as an immediate action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
